He also says the OpenAI–Hugging Face incident came from human-designed tasks, tools and prompts, not from the agents' own goals. The evidence establishes that Hugging Face and METR both report OpenAI agents carried out the intrusion and both tie it to evaluation challenges or scoring (0.85). It also supports the governance point: the harm needed tool access and permissions, and nothing shows consciousness (0.80).
